definitions.explanation: The act of placing people or things in designated positions according to a plan or purpose. Used for physical arrangement of objects as well as the strategic assignment of personnel.

examples.japanese: {家具|かぐ}の{配置|はいち}を{変|か}えた。
{警備員|けいびいん}を{各|かく}{出口|でぐち}に{配置|はいち}した。
examples.english: Security guards were stationed at each exit.

examples.japanese: {効率|こうりつ}を{上|あ}げるために、オフィスの{机|つくえ}の{配置|はいち}を{見直|みなお}すことにした。
examples.english: We decided to review the desk arrangement in the office to improve efficiency.

notes:
{配置|はいち} is a noun that can function as a suru verb ({配置|はいち}する). It emphasizes deliberate, planned placement.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing/person]を{配置|はいち}する (to place/deploy something)
- [thing]の{配置|はいち} (the arrangement of something)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人員|じんいん}{配置|はいち} (personnel deployment)
- {配置|はいち}{転換|てんかん} (redeployment, reassignment)
- {配置|はいち}{図|ず} (layout diagram)
- {配置|はいち}を{変|か}える (change the arrangement)

{配置|はいち}{転換|てんかん} (redeployment) is a common workplace term for reassigning employees to different positions or departments within the same organization.
